title: 43560001-Kabuki_Warriors.xiso.iso
order: After the DOA pair is read. L1 then L2, both ref 262e30e6de, both queued with request.sh --title 43560001-Kabuki_Warriors.xiso.iso --route kabuki-warriors --seconds 600 --perflog --device nova --hard-pin --env HAKUX_PLC_WIPE=1, back to back. L1 need not be 'cleared': with no Kabuki records and the cache file removed it is cold for Kabuki even with DOA's keys kept. L2 must be 'kept'.
judge: python3 docs/lanes/shaderprebuild569/pbjudge.py --l1 <L1 dir> --l2 <L2 dir> --boot-mark gameplay (--selftest passes). The kabuki-warriors route marks only 'gameplay' (lane.uberspike569's arm A: at 223 s), so it is the boot mark and there is no load leg.
prediction: #569 P3 on Kabuki Warriors, the heavy case: lane.uberspike569's cold arm A on this route created 836 pipelines in 140.4 s of draw-path time. L2 pre-builds L1's records (about 836 at ~168 ms on three workers: about 47 s) against mark gameplay at about 223 s. Registered: W4, L2's mean known create after mark gameplay <= 0.10 x L1's mean new create after it; W1, L2's whole-run draw-path create ms <= 0.25 x L1's; W2, L2's [pb569] done before its mark gameplay; W3, L2's median gfps before mark gameplay >= 0.90 x L1's.

legs.V (validity): As the DOA prediction's V, with mark gameplay as the boot mark.
legs.W4: L2 known-after-gameplay mean us <= 0.10 x L1 new-after-gameplay mean us. FAILS as the DOA W4, or where the pre-build has not reached Kabuki's fight pipelines by the fight.
legs.W2: L2's [pb569] done before its mark gameplay. FAILS if ~836 pipelines take longer than the menus on three workers; that is the case the 2048-record cap and the first-seen order exist for.
legs.W3: L2's median gfps before mark gameplay >= 0.90 x L1's: 47 s of three busy workers during the menus is the most this lane asks of the Nova's cores.
